title: Beach Trips in India: Short Breaks from Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata and Delhi
seoTitle: Beach Trips in India: Short Breaks from Major Cities | Kudozz Club
metaDescription: Beach trips from Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Ahmedabad and Delhi: the nearest good beaches, travel times and weekend ideas.
description: A guide to short beach trips from India's big cities: Alibaug, Kashid and the Konkan from Mumbai and Pune, Gokarna, Udupi and Pondicherry from Bengaluru, Covelong, Mahabalipuram and Pondicherry from Chennai, Vizag from Hyderabad, Digha and Puri from Kolkata, Diu and Shivrajpur from Ahmedabad, and fly-in beach weekends from Delhi.
dek: Most big Indian cities are within a train ride or a short flight of a good beach. Here are the best beach trips from each, for a weekend or a long weekend.
searchIntent: Short or weekend beach trips from major cities

intro: Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata are on the sea, and Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad are within a day's drive or a short flight of it. Even from Delhi, a Goa beach weekend is a two-hour flight. This guide lists the best beach trips from each city, with rough travel times and what each suits.
Travel times are approximate and depend on traffic and route. For longer holidays, see beach holidays in India.
quickAnswer: The best beach trips from major Indian cities are Alibaug, Kashid and the Konkan from Mumbai and Pune; Gokarna, Udupi and Pondicherry from Bengaluru; Covelong, Mahabalipuram and Pondicherry from Chennai; Vizag and Goa from Hyderabad; Digha, Mandarmani and Puri from Kolkata; Diu, Daman and Shivrajpur from Ahmedabad; and Goa by air from Delhi. Weekends suit trips under five hours; take a long weekend for more.
takeaways: From Mumbai, Alibaug is reachable by ferry and road in two to three hours.
From Bengaluru, Pondicherry is about six to seven hours by road; Gokarna is an overnight journey.
From Chennai, Covelong and Mahabalipuram are day trips on the East Coast Road.
From Kolkata, Digha and Mandarmani are about four to five hours away.
From Delhi, the practical beach weekend is a flight to Goa.

items.name: Alibaug, Nagaon and Kashid
body: The closest good beaches to Mumbai, by ferry to Mandwa plus road (ferries stop in the monsoon), or about three to four hours by road. From Pune, about three to four hours by road.

items.name: Diveagar, Shrivardhan and Harihareshwar
body: Quieter Raigad beaches, about four to five hours by road.

items.name: Ganpatipule and Guhagar
body: Temple and Blue Flag beaches in Ratnagiri, about six to eight hours by road or by Konkan Railway to Ratnagiri or Chiplun.

items.name: Tarkarli and Malvan
body: Clear water and snorkelling in Sindhudurg, an overnight train or long drive.

items.name: Daman and Goa
body: Daman is about four hours north by road; Goa is an overnight train or a one-hour flight.

items.name: Pondicherry
body: About six to seven hours by road, for the French Quarter, Paradise Beach and Serenity.

items.name: Gokarna and Murudeshwar
body: Overnight bus or train, for coves and Netrani dive trips.

items.name: Udupi and Malpe
body: Overnight, or a flight to Mangaluru, for St Mary's Island and temple towns.

items.name: Goa, Varkala and Kovalam
body: A short flight to Goa or Thiruvananthapuram makes a beach weekend possible.

items.name: Kovalam (Covelong) and Mahabalipuram
body: About one to one and a half hours along the East Coast Road, for surfing and the Shore Temple.

items.name: Pondicherry
body: About three hours along the East Coast Road.

items.name: Tranquebar
body: About five to six hours, for a quiet Danish-era beach town.

items.name: Visakhapatnam
body: A short flight or an overnight train to Vizag's beaches at Rushikonda, Yarada and Bheemili.

items.name: Goa and Gokarna
body: Flights to Goa, or an overnight journey towards Gokarna.

items.name: Digha, Shankarpur, Tajpur and Mandarmani
body: About four to five hours by road, or by train to Digha.

items.name: Bakkhali
body: About three to four hours, a quieter beach near the Sundarbans.

items.name: Puri and Chandipur
body: Overnight trains to Puri; Chandipur is reachable via Balasore.

items.name: Diu
body: About seven to eight hours by road, or a short flight, for Nagoa and Ghoghla.

items.name: Dwarka and Shivrajpur
body: About seven to eight hours by road or overnight train, for the Blue Flag beach and temple.

items.name: Daman and Tithal
body: About five to six hours south by road.

rows: Road, 5 to 8 hours, or a flight to Diu

sections.heading: Planning a beach weekend
list: Leave on Friday evening or very early on Saturday to make the most of two days.
Avoid long weekends and holidays if you can; coastal roads and ferries get very busy.
Book stays early for December to February weekends.
Check whether ferries are running: most harbour ferries stop in the monsoon.
Pick one beach and stay put rather than hopping between several.

sections.heading: From Delhi
paras: Delhi is far from the sea, so beach weekends mean flying. Goa is about two and a half hours by air, and a three-day weekend is enough for one area. For longer breaks, fly to Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair) for the Andamans, or to Thiruvananthapuram or Kochi for Kerala's beaches.

items.name: Goa by air
body: The most practical beach weekend from Delhi; choose one area to avoid long transfers.

safety: Swim only at beaches with lifeguards, inside the flagged zone, and never when a red flag is up or during the monsoon.
Weekend crowds at popular beaches can make water sports busy; choose licensed operators.
Check ferry and boat schedules; many coastal ferries stop in the monsoon.
Avoid driving long coastal and ghat roads at night.

faqs.q: Which is the nearest good beach to Mumbai?
faqs.a: Alibaug, Nagaon and Kashid, reachable by ferry and road in two to three hours.

faqs.q: Which beach is nearest to Bengaluru?
faqs.a: Pondicherry is about six to seven hours by road; Gokarna and Udupi are overnight journeys.

faqs.q: Which beaches can I visit from Kolkata on a weekend?
faqs.a: Digha, Shankarpur, Tajpur, Mandarmani and Bakkhali.

faqs.q: Is there a beach near Delhi?
faqs.a: No. The nearest practical beach weekend is a flight to Goa.
Kovalam (Covelong), Mahabalipuram and Pondicherry along the East Coast Road.
